annotations.title: Judge marriage: promise, dated windows and verdict

description: The marriage verdict from the judgment core, the same function the app chat answers from. One promise (present, weak or denied) with a single 0-100 score, confirmed from the lagna, the Moon and the Navamsa; the character of the partner (7th house and lord, Venus or Jupiter as karaka by sex, Upapada, Darakaraka); the periods the chart ties to marriage, in date order, from three layers (Vimshottari lords tied to the 7th house at Maha, Antar and Pratyantar level, the Jupiter-Saturn double transit from the lagna and the Moon, and K.N. Rao's Chara dasha), where the two lifting layers count only when they are selective in this chart (their base rates are in verdict.layers) and a period held by the dasha alone is still reported; the three strongest reasons and the main counter-reason, each with its classical source; and past windows to confirm with the person. Pass married: true for someone already married: no future windows are given and the past windows are offered to pick from. The windows have shown no measured lift over chance on dated marriages (verdict.timingEvidence): present them as what the traditional method reads in the chart, without ranking them or implying a likelihood, and ask whether the person is already married before giving future windows. Planning windows, never a guaranteed marriage; nothing is said about separation, loss of a spouse or further marriages.

asOfIso.description: ISO date the windows are split at into ahead and past; default today

married.description: The person is already married: past windows only

profileRef.description: A saved profile's reference (list_people). When sex is not given, a signed-in owner's call reads the sex saved on that profile.

sex.description: Chooses the karaka: Venus for a man's wife, Jupiter for a woman's husband. Without it Venus leads and Jupiter is read beside it.
